subject: boxplot and coord_flip - how to rotate legend key to expected orientation?

messages.author: 8acf4c2cbff2e7eb
messages.subject: boxplot and coord_flip - how to rotate legend key to expected orientation?
parts:
When generating the legend for a boxplot that has the coordinated
flipped, the legend keys are not also 'flipped' (rotated) to the
expected orientation (they are the same as without coord_flip). Is
there any way to manually set this (and is this a bug)?

I tried setting the shape using scale_shape_manual without any luck
(didn't really think it would/should work with geom_boxplot, though).

Here is some code to demonstrate the issue:

ggplot(diamonds, aes(x=clarity, y=price/carat, fill=diamonds$color %in
% as.factor(c("D","E","F"))))
+ geom_boxplot(alpha=0.2)
+ coord_flip()
+ scale_fill_manual(name="Color", values=c("blue","red"),
labels=c("Near Colorless","Colorless"))
+ opts(legend.position="top")

Not a huge issue, but I am generating a bunch of these
programmatically on a regular basis, and post-processing the legend is
not really an option.

Thanks,

MN
